scope: Every changed README/article.tex raw unified diff; selected actual target statement/proof spans; binary PDFs hash-only. Not whole-manuscript or external theorem certification.
span_convention: Inclusive 1-based lines. Raw spans concatenate splitlines(keepends=True); normalized spans remove CR/LF terminators and append exactly one LF per line.

cross_references.method: Complete namespace-label strings occurring in added diff lines, including pre-existing references repeated in modified long lines; namespace-only prefixes excluded. Targets resolved in actual pinned TeX bytes.

limitations: No supplied/frozen program execution/import, including copied programs.
No Lean, PDF, LaTeX or manuscript build. Ten changed PDFs are byte-authenticated only.
External Glazer Borel-standard-system premise and other literature theorems were not independently checked.
Generic Lean declaration excerpts were inspected as text; no specialized Lean theorem or kernel check is claimed.
No article outside the explicitly listed spans and changed raw diffs is claimed fully read.
No external bibliographic-date, historical priority, universe-wide absence, or delivered-build claim is independently certified.
